capabilities: Convert default-syntax Vimwiki pages to Markdown notes
Preview conversion output and warnings before import
Remap local wiki links to the new note paths
Convert lists, checkboxes, and code blocks
Map ISO diary filenames into a daily-note folder (Pro)
extras: Freemium: diary mapping and combined unresolved-link reports require a paid Pro tier; one payment unlocks Pro in all NoteMods plugins. The plugin opens a 'What's new' tab after updates that promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. The README openly lists untested platforms and scenarios (Linux, Windows, mobile, large migrations).
problem: Obsidian cannot read Vimwiki's default syntax, so pages migrated from Vimwiki keep broken formatting and wiki links.

relations.evidence: Vimwiki Import converts default Vimwiki pages that are already in your vault into Markdown notes.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/mo or $15 once) for Pro features

summary: Converts default-syntax Vimwiki .wiki pages already in the vault into Markdown notes with working local links, via a preview and import report.
